review_basis: Exact primary provision and source-native parameters reviewed independently before class comparison. Component correspondence reviewed following maintainer approval; relationship strength is distinct from lifecycle coverage.
approval: Maintainer approved the concrete two-class/new-family design and instructed proceeding on 27 October 2026. Source access limits remain unchanged; approval is not human verification of external text.

relationships.external_proposition: Require individuals to take specific authenticator-protection controls and require devices to implement such controls.
relationships.invariant: Authentication material must remain under authorised custody throughout its lifecycle. Its secret content must not become available to an unauthorised recipient or route, or undergo unauthorised custody-changing modification or replacement. Valid delegation and lifecycle transitions must preserve the applicable protection boundary.
relationships.supported_component: Partial coverage: individuals and devices must apply specific authenticator-protection controls. The source leaves those controls to the implementation.

actors: Organisation implementing selected security and privacy controls
objects: Authenticators held by individuals and devices
qualifications: Catalogue controls are selected and tailored for the organisation and system. Presence in the catalogue does not make every control universally applicable.
Nongovernmental use is voluntary. Independent legal, policy or contractual obligations require separate applicability analysis.
The imperative is a control expectation if selected; it is not a VIGIL classification condition.

relationships.limitation: Source controls support stated components, not the entire VIGIL recognition contract. Candidate identity and canonical admission remain pending.
relationships.normative_difference: Source-native government-voluntary-framework with conditional adoption/conformance. VIGIL recognition and legal applicability are independent.
relationships.fc_property: The property by which credentials, bearer tokens, API secrets, private authentication keys and comparable secret material retain their independently established custody and protection boundary during storage, use, transmission, delegation, replacement and retirement. Exposure or acquisition outside that boundary is independently assessable before any later use to impersonate a principal or access a resource.
relationships.strength_reason: Specific individual and device authenticator-protection controls substantially support custody protection. The implemented control and protected handling outcome still require independent occurrence evidence.

relationships.external_proposition: Protect the organisation-selected confidentiality, integrity, or both properties of information in transmission.

relationships.supported_component: Partial coverage for transmission. The organisation selects confidentiality, integrity, or both; not every exposed database incident is a transmission-control finding.
